name: ai-duel
title: Combat duel
description: Mini game 3: your Gunship 3 against an AI Gunship 3 in Hunting mode, 90 m off to one side, among rubble asteroids. The AI sees you within 150 m, closes to a stand-off of 35-55 m (by its combat skill), matches your motion, leads its aim and fires explosive shells when it has a clear shot. Knock out its engines or its hull to win; lose yours and you lose. Destroyed parts burst into dust. Rocks block shots both ways. Sliders: the AI's combat and flight skill.

ui.lookFor: Fly with Q and E, fire with F. The AI Gunship (e1) is hunting you: it closes in, holds off at a few dozen metres and fires explosive shells, leading its aim. Keep moving, use the rocks for cover, and shoot back. The readout shows both ships' health; knock out its engines or hull to win.
